Q2rjd602hws.desc:
Pat breaks down how professional players really look at the 1-on-1 basketball scene.

For NBA guys, 1v1 or 3v3 usually isn’t treated like some huge standalone competition. It’s another tool in the workout — similar to a boxer sparring in the gym.

The real priority is still 5-on-5 basketball, team concepts, conditioning, reads, and preparing for actual games. One-on-one work might come before or after practice to sharpen specific skills, get reps, or compete — but it’s not necessarily the thing players are building their entire day around.

Different perspective when basketball is your job. 👀
